reasons.committed->raw_expired: the raw media reached its thirty-day expiry
reasons.committed->raw_revoked: the coachee revoked consent for the raw media
reasons.committed->severed: the coachee's identity was severed while the raw media was live
reasons.paused->discarded: the capture can never be processed, so it never enters the pipeline
reasons.paused->recording: both parties consented again after the pause
reasons.paused->uploading: the session ended while paused; what was captured still uploads
reasons.processing->aborted: consent was withdrawn mid-run, so the run is discarded
reasons.queued->discarded: the capture can never be processed, so it never enters the pipeline
reasons.queued->processing: the consent gate passed at the processing checkpoint
reasons.raw_expired->severed: the coachee's identity was severed after expiry
reasons.raw_revoked->severed: the coachee's identity was severed after revocation
reasons.recording->discarded: the capture can never be processed, so it never enters the pipeline
reasons.recording->paused: a third party joined, or either party stopped the recording
reasons.uploading->discarded: the capture can never be processed, so it never enters the pipeline
reasons.uploading->queued: the ciphertext is stored and the server verified its digest

refusals_to_start.chain_broken: The consent record for this engagement does not verify, so it cannot be relied on, and nothing has been recorded.
refusals_to_start.clock_skew: This device's clock disagrees with the consent record's, so timings cannot be trusted, and nothing has been recorded.
refusals_to_start.ledger_unreachable: Darpana could not reach the consent record, so it cannot confirm that consent is live, and nothing has been recorded.
refusals_to_start.no_engagement: There is no engagement on file for this session, so nothing may be recorded, uploaded or analysed.
refusals_to_start.not_signed: All three parties have not yet signed the current agreement, so nothing may be recorded until they have.
refusals_to_start.policy_missing: The version of the agreement this engagement signed is not available, so its terms cannot be read, and nothing has been recorded.
refusals_to_start.reconsent_pending: The agreement has changed and is waiting to be signed again, so this engagement is paused and nothing is being processed.
refusals_to_start.revoked: Consent for this engagement has been withdrawn, so the recording may no longer be used and nothing further will be processed.
refusals_to_start.scope_not_granted: This engagement did not grant permission for this kind of processing, so it will not be carried out.
refusals_to_start.severed: This engagement has been severed at the coachee's request, so no recording may be made or used under it.
refusals_to_start.signature_unverifiable: A signature on the consent record cannot be verified, so consent cannot be relied on, and nothing has been recorded.
